title: A Day at the Farmers' Market

parts.script:
Maria: Hey Tom, have you ever been to the local farmers' market on Saturdays?  
Tom: No, I haven't. What's it like?  
Maria: It's great! There are so many fresh fruits and vegetables. I love buying organic produce.  
Tom: That sounds nice. Do they sell anything else?  
Maria: Yes! You can find homemade jams, fresh bread, and even local honey.  
Tom: Wow! Do you usually go there every week?  
Maria: I try to! It's a perfect way to support local farmers, and the atmosphere is so lively.  
Tom: That’s awesome. What time does it open?  
Maria: It starts at 8 AM and goes until 1 PM. I usually go early to get the best selection.  
Tom: I might check it out this Saturday. Any tips for a first-timer?  
Maria: Bring cash, as not all vendors accept cards, and wear comfortable shoes! You'll be walking around a lot.  
Tom: Thanks for the tips! I’ll definitely join you this week.  
Maria: Great! We can grab some coffee from the stall there too.  
Tom: Sounds like a plan!
